prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic close-up shot of an old CRT television screen displaying a retro, analog interface. In the center of the screen, the year "1990" is prominently displayed in bold, white, sans-serif text. On the left side of the screen, show a small, grainy, black-and-white photograph of a person with wild, curly hair and sunglasses, evoking a rebellious or rock-and-roll aesthetic. On the right side, include a similarly sized, blue-tinted, low-resolution image of a person in motion, possibly running or walking briskly, with a sense of urgency or surveillance. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by cool blues, grays, and the soft glow of the CRT. The lighting is dim, with the screen itself providing the primary illumination, casting a subtle glow on the surrounding darkness. The composition is symmetrical and minimalistic, with a strong sense of nostalgia and vintage technology, reminiscent of archival footage or a documentary style. The camera angle is straight-on, emphasizing the flatness and curvature of the old monitor, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the screen’s content while the edges blur softly into shadow.
